class InputReader {

    InputReader(istream& stream): stream(stream), buf(1024), curChar(0), numChars(0) {}

    int read() {
        if (numChars == -1) throw runtime_error("InputMismatch");
        if (curChar >= numChars) {
            stream.read(buf.data(), buf.size());

            if (numChars <= 0) return -1;
            curChar=0;

class Point {
public:
    double x,y;
    Point(double x, double y): x(x), y(y) {}
    bool operator==(const Point& o) const {
        return fabs(x - o.x)<=1e-5 && fabs(y - o.y)<=1e-5;
    }
    double distance(const Point& o) const{
        return sqrt((x - o.x)*(x - o.x)+(y - o.y)*(y - o.y));
    }
    Point rotate(double angle) const {
        double nx=x*cos(angle)-y*sin(angle);
        double ny=y*cos(angle)+x*sin(angle);
        return Point(nx,ny);
